message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No newly reported vulnerability was confirmed to affect the normalized DLL/component inventory during the last 24 hours.

**Scope:** `DLL_software_component.txt` only, normalized and deduplicated. `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-18 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-19 07:40 UTC (2026-10-18 13:10 IST through 2026-10-19 13:10 IST).

### Findings

No confirmed relevant findings.

Fresh CVE and advisory records were checked against the named libraries, SDKs, packages, commercial components, exact versions, and obvious aliases. The newly published October 18-19 records located in the broad sweep affected unrelated products; similarly named items such as the WordPress “Bootstrap Shortcodes” plugin were rejected as false matches. Reviewed NuGet and npm advisory listings also showed no new in-scope package advisories during the window.

Sources checked included the [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories), [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/search), [Microsoft Security Update Guide](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/), vendor security/release pages, and [CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities](https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog).

### Possible matches needing review

None.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The required independent sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations and libraries, MongoDB-owned notices, CVE/NVD records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA sources. No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported or materially updated in the scan window. The newest security entries visible on the [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts) feed were dated October 8, 2026 and were excluded as stale.

### Review priority

No immediate review is indicated from a confirmed in-scope finding. Continue routine monitoring; older known vulnerabilities and unsupported component versions were outside this freshness-only scan.
